methodology.cfb_freeze: CFB freezes the first executable pregame side when one exists; otherwise it retains the earliest pregame Model A forecast. A candidate execution quote must be two-sided, no older than 30 minutes, priced no worse than -125 and within 3 spread points of consensus. If none qualifies, the frozen consensus line is the fallback.
methodology.cfb_close: CFB closing CLV uses the captured price nearest kickoff inside the closing-proxy window from 90 minutes before kickoff through 10 minutes after kickoff. The proxy is disclosed because it is not represented as an official universal close.
methodology.cbb_freeze: CBB freezes the pregame projection retained by the projection board. Starting with this contract release, the projection object carries its actual generated-at timestamp and keeps it after settlement. Earlier finals with no archived projection timestamp are labeled NOT ARCHIVED; THI does not reconstruct one.
methodology.cbb_market: CBB spread and total consensus values are the median across available book lines after orientation validation, rounded to the nearest half-point for the grading contract. Opening is THI's first capture unless a source explicitly supplies an opener. Available providers vary by game.
methodology.clv: CLV compares the tracked side or total at its frozen pregame line with the captured closing line. Positive points mean the frozen number beat the close. Beat-close percentage excludes exact ties; results and CLV display separate sample counts.
methodology.intervals: Binary hit rates and calibration buckets use 95% Wilson score intervals. MAE, RMSE, signed bias, Brier score and mean CLV use 2,000 fixed-seed bootstrap resamples (seed 42). These intervals quantify sampling uncertainty; they do not certify an edge.
methodology.sample: Rows with fewer than 100 graded decisions are labeled SMALL SAMPLE. The warning is interpretive and never changes, hides or promotes a result.
methodology.historical: Historical backtests are research evidence, not prospective validation. They remain separate from every prospective figure on this page.

source_coverage.counting_rule: A multi-book CBB game contributes once to each available provider; provider counts can exceed the game total. CFB contributes its frozen execution source or consensus fallback once.

cfb: Every confidence tier remains DEVELOPING until the complete promotion contract clears.
Positive CLV in a small tier is not validation without sufficient sample, stability and price coverage.
cbb: CBB remains a research environment; spread tiers are not yet clearing THI's performance and CLV standards.
The middle probability bands require continued calibration monitoring; the dashboard reports the gap instead of smoothing it away.
Historical CBB finals created before prospective projection timestamps were added are explicitly labeled NOT ARCHIVED rather than backfilled.
